title: The backlog tool's done, land, close, cost, intake and CI tests are one per command and its push guards
goal: The 16 test files of backlog.py's done, land, close, cost, stall, procs, selfcheck, red-pipeline, intake and merge (test_bl_land.py, test_bl_land_mainspool.py, test_bl_land_workrows.py, test_ops_land.py, test_land_tiers.py, test_bl_cost.py, test_cost_open_session*.py, test_bl_stall.py, test_bl_procs.py, test_bl_selfcheck.py, test_bl_ci.py, test_intake.py, test_bl_intake_filing.py, test_bl_merge.py) hold only the 17 tests the notes' KEEP list names (652 ids on 2026-10-05), every removed id is in _tools/test_ids_dropped.txt under a reason line naming the operator's direction of 2026-10-05 and the kept test of its file that still reaches the module, and every tool module is still reached by a test; a full tests.py spends about 500 worker-seconds less (about 1.2 min of wall on macOS, about 5.4 min on the Windows host). It no longer catches: land's worktree and branch clean-up cases, its return to the start branch, its stuck auto-merge reports and wait-merge paths; close's link and gate clean-up; every cost total, shared, overhead and research rule; each stall signal; the selfcheck caps; the job-state table of red-pipeline; intake's drift rotation, trailers, stranded and replay detectors; the ops rows of land, done, close and intake. They show in the land.step, land.end, done.refused, sprint.close and intake.detect ops rows and the digest.
notes: KEEP, test_ names without the prefix, [1] the first case (all else in these files goes): bl_land: done_refuses_failing_check_and_scope_then_passes, unmerged_code_commit_is_refused_naming_the_branch, backlog_land_content_item_in_one_run, backlog_land_code_item_waits_for_its_merge_request_then_finishes, backlog_land_stops_at_the_failing_step_and_names_it, review_needs_confirmed_provisional_answers_and_close_deletes, close_removes_worker_leftovers; bl_cost: backlog_cost_sums_descendants_per_model_main_sub_and_cw_apart; bl_stall: stalled_items_by_signal_all_seven_at_once_and_the_quiet_items_unlisted; bl_procs: procs_names_orphans_never_signals_through_the_command; bl_selfcheck: selfcheck_names_remedy_command_in_a_scratch_clone_fails_with_remedies; bl_ci: red_pipeline_files_one_s2_bug_per_pipeline, real_forge_log_red_pipeline_files_one_bug_per_real_failure; intake: intake_core_prints_candidates_and_writes_nothing, intake_core_file_writes_draft_items_outside_any_sprint, intake_hook_never_commits_or_pushes; bl_merge: merge_only_own_code_branch. Whole files go: bl_land_mainspool, bl_land_workrows, ops_land, land_tiers, cost_open_session, cost_open_session_main, cost_open_session_reopened, bl_intake_filing. Premise: pytest --collect-only -q over the 16 files collects 652 (7fbf1f2d5). Measured on macOS, one process: test_bl_land.py 224 s (TestBacklogLand 132, 3-5 s a test), test_intake.py 88, test_bl_cost.py 77; the rest from the last full run, pro rata; Windows minutes scale the macOS share to 25 min. The checks pass before the work. The Windows bugs BG-lt3zjywp and BG-sivjh67q name tests in test_bl_land.py this deletes. No gate: test files and reasons only, under the operator's settled direction.
